svg.text: Every Monday, every tracked repo’s releases from the past 7 days. Flags need quoted evidence. Keerthi decides what to upgrade.
repos · releases · classifications (AI cache: release + body hash + model) · digest_runs (unique ISO week) · digest_items · deliveries · recipients · run log · audit log
• Evidence before urgency: a flag needs a quoted line from the notes, a GitHub advisory, or a major bump.
• Nothing is hidden: every in-window release appears, as a card, a line, or “+N earlier releases”.
• Free to run: Vercel Hobby · Supabase free · Gemini Flash · Resend. Releases only, no scraping.
